verdict.rationale: The pricing page is public (resend.com/pricing) and evidence shows some concrete details—add-on capacity ('adds 100 more on top of it', available on Pro/Scale) and SSO gating by plan—plus community comparisons imply published monthly tiers that founders can compare without a sales call. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit per-volume tier tables, overage per-email rates, or a stated cost for dedicated IPs/validation as a line item. missing for 10: explicit volume-tier pricing table, overage/per-email rate figures, validation service cost, dedicated-IP add-on price.
